# ## EcEvents_Silver
#
# Bronze : raw ecEvents export (camelCase headers, TimeStamp as 'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')
# Silver : snake_case, typed, deduplicated, and MERGEd into the Silver table on ec_event_gkey
#          so consecutive runs are idempotent (re-sent rows update, new rows insert).

# In[1]:


TERMINAL_CODE = "CT03"
FULL_REFRESH  = False        # True = rebuild Silver from Bronze (overwrite) instead of MERGE
RUN_ID    = datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
# ── Storage ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
STORAGE_ACCOUNT = "navispowerbidatastorage2"
CONTAINER       = "adani-ct03"   # <-- adjust to this terminal's container

BRONZE_PATH = (
    f"abfss://{CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    f"bronze/ecevents/load"     # <-- adjust to the raw location
)
ARCHIVE_ROOT = (
    f"abfss://{CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    f"bronze/ecevents/load"
)
SILVER_PATH = (
    f"abfss://{CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    f"silver/ecevents/"
)

MERGE_KEY         = "ec_event_gkey"
SENTINEL_DISTANCE = 100_000_000

# ── Accepted timestamp formats (first successful parse wins) ───────────────────
# Current source format is FIRST. Separators differ, so these cannot clash.
# dd/MM/yyyy and MM/dd/yyyy CLASH for days 1-12 -> enable ONE of them, never both.
TS_FORMATS = [
    "dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss",         # current source: 15-10-2026 00:00:05
    "dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss",         # possible future: 15/10/2026 00:00:05
    "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss",         # ISO (e.g. if Bronze already holds a timestamp)
    "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS",
    # "MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss",       # US order - enable ONLY if the source is US and dd/MM/yyyy is removed
]

print(f"Terminal   : {TERMINAL_CODE}")
print(f"Bronze     : {BRONZE_PATH}")
print(f"Silver     : {SILVER_PATH}")
print(f"Merge key  : {MERGE_KEY}")
print(f"TS formats  : {TS_FORMATS}")
print(f"Full refresh: {FULL_REFRESH}")
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

from notebookutils import mssparkutils      # Fabric. On Databricks use dbutils.fs instead

def list_csv(path):
    """Recursively list .csv files under path (empty list if the folder doesn't exist)."""
    try:
        items = mssparkutils.fs.ls(path)
    except Exception:
        return []
    out = []
    for it in items:
        if it.isDir:
            out += list_csv(it.path)
        elif it.name.lower().endswith(".csv"):
            out.append(it)
    return out

load_files = list_csv(LOAD_PATH)                    # these, and only these, get archived
read_files = list(load_files)
if FULL_REFRESH:                                    # rebuild needs history too
    read_files += list_csv(ARCHIVE_ROOT)

if not load_files and not FULL_REFRESH:
    print("No new files in load folder, nothing to do.")
    mssparkutils.notebook.exit("no new files")

print(f"New files to process: {len(load_files)}")
bronze = bronze = (
    spark.read
    .format("csv")
    .option("header", "true")
    .option("inferSchema", "false")         # keep everything as string; build_col does the typing
    .option("recursiveFileLookup", "true")  # include sub-folders of the load folder
    .load(BRONZE_PATH)
)
# trim spaces / BOM in header names so COLUMN_SPEC matches
bronze = bronze.toDF(*[c.strip().lstrip("\ufeff") for c in bronze.columns])


print(f"Bronze rows   : {bronze.count():,}")
print(f"Bronze columns: {len(bronze.columns)}")
bronze.printSchema()

missing = [src for src, _, _ in COLUMN_SPEC if src not in bronze.columns]
if missing:
    print(f"\n⚠️  Columns in COLUMN_SPEC not found in bronze (will be skipped): {missing}")

# ── Select, rename & cast ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
available = set(bronze.columns)
spec      = [(s, t, k) for s, t, k in COLUMN_SPEC if s in available]

typed = bronze.select(*[build_col(s, k).alias(t) for s, t, k in spec])

# ── Fail loudly if any non-empty timestamp could not be parsed ────────────────
_ts_cols = [(s, t) for s, t, k in spec if k == "ts"]
if _ts_cols:
    _src = bronze.agg(*[F.sum(F.when(F.trim(F.col(f"`{s}`").cast("string")) != "", 1).otherwise(0)).alias(t)
                        for s, t in _ts_cols]).collect()[0]
    _dst = typed.agg(*[F.count(F.col(t)).alias(t) for _, t in _ts_cols]).collect()[0]
    _bad = {t: (_src[t] or 0) - (_dst[t] or 0) for _, t in _ts_cols if (_src[t] or 0) != (_dst[t] or 0)}
    assert not _bad, f"Timestamp parse failures (column: rows). Add the new format to TS_FORMATS: {_bad}"
    print(f"Timestamp check OK for {len(_ts_cols)} columns")

# ── Nullify sentinel distance values ──────────────────────────────────────────
for dist_col in ["travel_distance", "start_distance"]:
    if dist_col in typed.columns:
        typed = typed.withColumn(
            dist_col,
            F.when(F.col(dist_col) >= F.lit(SENTINEL_DISTANCE), None)
             .otherwise(F.col(dist_col))
        )

# ── Derived columns ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
units = F.split(F.col("unit_nbrs"), ";")
typed = (
    typed
    .withColumn("event_date", F.to_date("event_ts"))
    # twin lifts arrive as "UNIT1;UNIT2"
    .withColumn("unit_1",     F.trim(units.getItem(0)))
    .withColumn("unit_2",     F.trim(units.getItem(1)))
    .withColumn("unit_count", F.when(F.col("unit_nbrs").isNull(), None).otherwise(F.size(units)))
)
for col, prefix in [("loc_slot", "loc"), ("unladen_loc_slot", "unladen"), ("laden_loc_slot", "laden")]:
    if col in typed.columns:
        typed = add_slot_parts(typed, col, prefix)

# ── Row hash: change detection for MERGE ──────────────────────────────────────
business_cols = [c for c in typed.columns]
typed = typed.withColumn("row_hash", F.xxhash64(*[F.col(c) for c in business_cols]))

# ── Deduplication ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
n_typed    = typed.count()
null_key   = typed.filter(F.col(MERGE_KEY).isNull()).count()
null_ts    = typed.filter(F.col("event_ts").isNull()).count()

# 1) rows without a key cannot be merged -> reject
keyed = typed.filter(F.col(MERGE_KEY).isNotNull())

# 2) exact duplicate rows
exact = keyed.dropDuplicates()

# 3) several versions of the same ecEventGkey -> keep the latest event_ts
#    (row_hash as tie-breaker so the result is deterministic)
w = Window.partitionBy(MERGE_KEY).orderBy(
        F.col("event_ts").desc_nulls_last(), F.col("row_hash").desc()
)
silver = (
    exact
    .withColumn("_rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("_rn") == 1)
    .drop("_rn")
    .withColumn("_silver_loaded_at", F.current_timestamp())
    .persist()
)

n_silver = silver.count()
n_exact  = exact.count()

print("=" * 55)
print(f"  Bronze rows read              : {n_typed:,}")
print(f"  Rejected (null {MERGE_KEY})  : {null_key:,}")
print(f"  Exact duplicates removed      : {n_typed - null_key - n_exact:,}")
print(f"  Key-version duplicates removed: {n_exact - n_silver:,}")
print(f"  Rows for MERGE                : {n_silver:,}")
print(f"  event_ts could not be parsed  : {null_ts:,}")
print("=" * 55)

display(
    silver.groupBy("event_type", "event_type_desc", "che_kind")
          .count().orderBy(F.desc("count"))

# ── MERGE on ec_event_gkey (consecutive runs) ─────────────────────────────────
from delta.tables import DeltaTable

if FULL_REFRESH or not DeltaTable.isDeltaTable(spark, SILVER_PATH):
    (
        silver.write
        .format("delta")
        .mode("overwrite")
        .option("overwriteSchema", "true")
        # .partitionBy("event_date")   # enable at high volume
        .save(SILVER_PATH)
    )
    print(f"✅  Initial load: {n_silver:,} rows → {SILVER_PATH}")
else:
    target = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, SILVER_PATH)
    (
        target.alias("t")
        .merge(silver.alias("s"), f"t.{MERGE_KEY} = s.{MERGE_KEY}")
        .whenMatchedUpdateAll(condition="t.row_hash <> s.row_hash")   # only if something changed
        .whenNotMatchedInsertAll()
        .execute()
    )
    m = target.history(1).select("operationMetrics").collect()[0][0]
    print("✅  MERGE complete")
    print(f"   inserted : {m.get('numTargetRowsInserted')}")
    print(f"   updated  : {m.get('numTargetRowsUpdated')}")
    print(f"   unchanged source rows skipped by row_hash check")

# ── Archive processed files (only reached if the MERGE above succeeded) ───────
archived = 0
for f in load_files:
    rel  = f.path.split(LOAD_PATH.rstrip("/") + "/", 1)[-1]      # keep sub-folder structure
    dest = f"{ARCHIVE_ROOT}/{RUN_ID}/{rel}"
    mssparkutils.fs.mv(f.path, dest, True)                       # True = create dest folders
    archived += 1

print(f"✅  Archived {archived} file(s) → {ARCHIVE_ROOT}/{RUN_ID}/")
silver.unpersist()

result = spark.read.format("delta").load(SILVER_PATH)

total    = result.count()
distinct = result.select(MERGE_KEY).distinct().count()

print(f"Rows         : {total:,}")
print(f"Distinct keys: {distinct:,}  {'✅' if total == distinct else '❌ duplicates in Silver'}")
print(f"Columns      : {len(result.columns)}")
print(f"Event range  : ", result.agg(F.min('event_ts'), F.max('event_ts')).collect()[0])
result.printSchema()
